blocks.text: As a longtime gamer and a proud collector who still owns pristine, black-label PlayStation 1 copies of the original trilogy, I walked into the theater wearing a heavy armor of skepticism. Let’s be honest: Hollywood’s track record with Capcom’s crown jewel has been a decades-long exercise in frustration. We first endured the nü-metal, leather-clad superhero gymnastics of the Paul W.S. Anderson era. Then came the well-intentioned but hollow, cosplay-level fan service of 2021’s Welcome to Raccoon City. After being burned so many times, the announcement of yet another reboot felt like opening a door only to find a Crimson Head waiting on […]...
